components.purpose: One bottom owner for contextual controls and voice.
invariants: One visible orb; no duplicate microphone control.
Global navigation never appears in the contextual carousel.
No context read or command execution caused by visibility, animation or scrolling.
Preserve entry-scoped action lease validation.

components.purpose: Named global destinations disclosed from the orb.
invariants: Hold, upward orb swipe and Menu open the same sheet.
Selected destination is expressed in text/semantics, not color alone.
Back closes disclosure before route navigation.
Invoking a root opens its landing page; current draft/session remains owned by its existing owner.

components.purpose: A recognizable action with a persistent adjacent label.
invariants: Icon and label form one focus and activation target.
Minimum 48dp hit target and non-overlapping label bounds.
No one-label-under-orb pattern.
No destructive action as a default prominent satellite.

components.purpose: Manual carousel for the current owner.
invariants: At most three visible controls; fewer when fewer actions exist.
Stable semantic ordering, no automatic rotation.
Drag never invokes action.
Full list exposes the same current-page action set, not a second catalog.
At large text/short height use labelled flat/list presentation.

components.purpose: Identify the current document/tool and provide back or close in the zone utility band.
invariants: Opening a tool visibly changes both working area and owner title.
Never silently replace only orbit actions.
Long titles wrap in the work area; essential back/close stays reachable.
Default Library; preserve local tab and scroll on return.
Tools list opens each actual owner directly.
No tool-launcher actions leak into Library or an editor.

components.purpose: A saved item with type, name, secondary metadata and true availability.
invariants: Icon encodes content type; label names actual object.
Unavailable content explains why and exposes recovery.
Selection mode changes actions explicitly and preserves actual IDs.

components.purpose: Nonintrusive contextual instruction with remembered dismissal.
invariants: One hint at a time.
Never steal focus or cover active drawing/typing/voice.
Dismissal is persisted according to catalog policy.
Help remains rediscoverable from Settings/Help.

components.purpose: Truthful outstanding attention derived from canonical events.
invariants: Deduplicate projections by canonical event/run/decision ID.
Unread, actionable, active and failed are distinct meanings.
Completion is not automatically an unread badge.
Color always paired with text, shape or count.
Empty only after successful empty load.
No fake progress or success from elapsed time.
Unavailability does not disable independent navigation or local editor actions.
